No actionable correctness or security findings in PR #2 at 9ebfdea.

  • CI gating is preserved: both new jobs feed CI Success, which rejects non-success results (ci.yml:522).
  • Intel wheels retain the same installation smoke profiles on actual Intel runners. Their reusable-workflow result gates CI and release assembly (native-wheels.yml:231, release-candidate.yml:116).
  • Release candidates explicitly supply source_revision, disabling the new compiled Rust cache (native-wheels.yml:124).
  • Worker results reach the controller before final session reporting; the Rayon guard and unavailable-dependency reports survive xdist. I checked this against installed xdist hook implementation and the added serial/parallel regression cases (conftest.py:357, test_collection_policy.py:89).
  • The sysmon change retains configured line coverage; no branch coverage or dynamic-context configuration is being dropped.

Read-only inspection only: no tests/builds/linters run, no files or GitHub state changed. Actual cross-build execution, coverage equivalence, cache behavior and CI timing remain dependent on root’s validation and hosted results.
